title: Gimbal video audio: 'a whole fleet of them'

tellings.quote: there's a whole fleet of them. Look on ASA.

related.note: The Gimbal crew audio saying 'a whole fleet of them' is about the same fleet accompanying the Gimbal object in 2015. The story only says the formation was possibly there, while this telling hears it stated by the crew on the tape.

plain: In the Gimbal video, a 2015 Navy infrared recording of an object off the US East Coast that seems to turn on its side as it flies, an unnamed member of the Navy aircrew can be heard saying, "there's a whole fleet of them. Look on ASA," meaning the radar display in the cockpit. The voice belongs to someone who was there that day. It suggests the crew were tracking a whole group of objects, and not just the one on camera.
